purpose: Evidence requirements for an R1 production release; automation cannot substitute for physical-device, visual-art, performance or human-comprehension evidence.

requirements.description: The release candidate is explicitly frozen to one source identity; any source-fingerprint change invalidates retained evidence.
requirements.spot_check: Record full HEAD, tree and fingerprint before qualification. Any post-freeze source change starts a new candidate evidence cycle.

requirements.description: The production-like deployment identifies the exact frozen candidate and a retained asset manifest.
requirements.spot_check: Read build identity from the deployed game, compare full HEAD/tree to the candidate, and retain/digest the deployed asset manifest.

requirements.description: Ready title cards remain reachable at desktop, portrait and landscape sizes.
requirements.spot_check: Load a fresh profile, wait for readiness, open and cancel each route. Check buttons at rendered hit targets.

requirements.description: Start Day, use the standup and workstation, then reload and Continue with saved state intact.
requirements.spot_check: Clock in, assign the queue, open MUSIC, return to the workstation and reload. Continue must show the same checkpoint with no hidden modal.

requirements.description: Interrupted standalone Night resumes a durable world without changing the campaign save.
requirements.spot_check: Move in standalone Night, open Run Menu, reload, then Resume Night. Compare position, health, district, enemies, rewards and campaign save.

requirements.description: Solo and local co-op selection survives cancellation and enforces keyboard capability.
requirements.spot_check: Cancel and reopen the selector. Touch alone must explain why local co-op is unavailable; a trusted keyboard event may enable it. Enter the three prologue scenes.

requirements.description: Missing codec remains visible until deliberate idempotent Skip.
requirements.spot_check: Force both capability probes false. No src or narrative completion may occur. Double Skip and late Escape must commit exactly once.

requirements.description: The R1 reference slice has human-reviewed checkpoint captures with no unresolved blocker at each required beat.
requirements.spot_check: Capture the same canonical slice at every required beat. A human reviewer confirms scale, pixel treatment, UI hierarchy, semantic interaction and absence of prototype-art leakage.

requirements.description: Minimum advertised keyboard/pointer/touch routes remain usable and semantically equivalent.
requirements.spot_check: Exercise every required input row. Progression must remain reachable; prompt and accepted action must agree; no row may lose or duplicate input.

requirements.description: Actual iPhone Safari and Android Chrome pass touch, rotation, background/resume, safe-area and audio-unlock acceptance.
requirements.spot_check: On each named physical device complete Day opening, Night restart/resume and Good Dogs prologue. Rotate twice, lock/unlock, switch apps, reopen browser and verify audio plus usable controls.

requirements.description: All nine retained MP4 assets decode in shipping browsers; eight are active routes and retired GD_CUT_03 is decode-only.
requirements.spot_check: Record browser/OS and all nine manifest filenames/digests. Observe advancing decoded frames for each asset; exercise pause/resume and Skip on active routes. GD_CUT_03 stays retired. Capability claims alone do not pass.

requirements.description: Representative save/reload boundaries restore equivalent canonical state without duplicated events, rewards or data loss.
requirements.spot_check: Save/reload each required boundary. Compare canonical state, reward/event counts and the next reachable player action.

requirements.description: Complete intended release routes without seeded state, API progression or test assistance.
requirements.spot_check: Retain input recording, terminal narrative state and save/reload checkpoints. Both local players use independent controls. Record every blocker and retry.

requirements.description: Measured first-playable and core-input latency meet declared budgets with zero decode failures or softlocks.
requirements.spot_check: Measure cold first playable and representative core input latency on the named profile. Record duration, long/blocking stalls, asset decode failures and softlocks; mobile evidence must identify a physical device.

requirements.description: Target devices sustain playable frame pacing, memory and thermal behavior through long sessions.
requirements.spot_check: Run at least 30 minutes per device through combat, scene changes and videos; record frame percentiles, peak memory where exposed, visible stalls and thermal observations.

requirements.description: A fresh-context human completes the R1 vertical slice without developer intervention or blocking comprehension failures.
requirements.spot_check: Give a tester no developer walkthrough. Record checkpoint completion, confusion points and terminal state. Any developer intervention or blocking confusion fails certification.

requirements.description: Every known release issue is severity-classified and zero open P0/P1 blockers remain.
requirements.spot_check: Reconcile the issue tracker and known-issues document. Open P2/P3 items require explicit disposition; unclassified issues and open P0/P1 block release.

requirements.description: A retained rollback plan is bound to the candidate and a tested rollback target, including forward-restore/save-compatibility checks.
requirements.spot_check: Record the full candidate and rollback SHAs, test rollback in a production-like environment, verify forward restore, and retain a digested rollback record.

requirements.description: The candidate has all declared required checks passing and enabled, enforced branch protection independently verified.
requirements.spot_check: Bind check runs to the exact candidate SHA. Verify protection is enabled and enforced, then match its required context names exactly to required_contexts in this inventory and retain a successful check for each. A permissions failure is unverified, never absent.
